newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI SOYBEANS END MOSTLY DOWN AMID WEAKNESS.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI SOYBEANS END MOSTLY DOWN AMID WEAKNESS.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mostly down on Thursday amid weak market sentiment, traders said.
The most actively traded September 1997 contract ended at an intraday low of 3,150 yuan ($380) per tonne, losing 10 yuan. It opened at a high of 3,160 yuan per tonne.
November fell two yuan to 3,138, the January 1998 contract rose 66 to 3,111 and March dropped two to 3,118 yuan per tonne.
Combined volume fell to 20,000 tonnes from 21,600 tonnes.
Soybeans opened little changed and fell only slightly throughout for session, traders said.
